Strange sightings, unexplained encounters and mysteries that challenge everything we know. The Expedition X team follows unusual leads into the unknown, investigating claims that have left witnesses searching for answers. With every new clue, the line between legend and reality gets harder to define. What secrets will their investigations uncover?
Watch Expedition X, Season 3, Episodes 10, 1, 7, 8, 5, 4, 2 and 3, on Discovery Channel India.
